result.rationale: The diff shows `isInvalidEmail` set to true in handleAdd on failed safeParse, but the only code that resets it is the cancel button (`setIsInvalidEmail(false)` inside the cancel onClick). Editing MultiEmail values via setValue never resets the flag, so after one failed validation the error message persists even after the user corrects the emails and re-adds successfully (onSuccess also never resets it). This is a verifiable UI-state defect introduced by this diff. The missing-test aspect is secondary.

adjudication.rationale: The diff adds nontrivial validation/state logic in `AddGuestsDialog` (e.g., initial `multiEmailValue` is `[""]`, `handleAdd` has an `if (multiEmailValue.length === 0) return;`, and sets `isInvalidEmail` to `true` on zod failure). Also, `isInvalidEmail` is only reset on Cancel (and not when the user edits `MultiEmail` values), so the error can persist after corrections—an edge case that would benefit from explicit component tests. However, the specific claim that “no component test covers” these cases can’t be definitively verified from the diff alone.
